method: Discovered immediately after merging Phase 4: PROJECT_STATE.json can never record its own commit's SHA, so exact-equality staleness check made verify() permanently BLOCKED after every single commit, including the resync commit meant to fix it. task: Fix Phase 4 check_state_freshness self-defeating staleness
summary: Fixed check_state_freshness()'s exact-equality staleness check, which was self-defeating: a committed state file can never record its own commit's SHA, so verify() would report BLOCKED after every commit forever, including the resync commit meant to fix it. Replaced with ancestor+distance logic (STALE_COMMIT_DISTANCE=5): not stale if recorded_commit is an ancestor of HEAD within 5 commits; stale if it's not an ancestor at all, or more than 5 commits behind.
